topic: Walking into a First Yoga Class

script.title: FIRST YOGA CLASS
script.scene_zh: 瑜伽教室 · 上第一堂課
script.story_hook: A stiff office worker discovers yoga is for him.
script.intro_zh: 一位久坐的上班族發現,瑜伽原來也屬於他。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: your very first yoga class.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來聽第一堂瑜伽課的對話。
script.outro: Sixty lines, and the mat suddenly feels friendly.
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,瑜伽墊突然變親切了。
script.practice_intro_en: Now breathe — and repeat every line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在深呼吸,每句話都跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: a man in his fifties with a salt-and-pepper crew cut, wearing round reading glasses, a light gray T-shirt and navy sweatpants, bare feet, heavy-set build, clutching a water bottle
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her late twenties with tight brown braids resting over one shoulder, wearing a teal oversized hoodie and black leggings, bare feet, tall lean build, holding a small wooden yoga block

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me — is this the yoga room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjus mi ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈjoʊɡə rum/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下,這裡是瑜伽教室嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! First class? I can tell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz fɜrst klæs aɪ kən tɛl/
dialogue.zh: 是呀!第一堂課吧?我看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it that obvious?
dialogue.zh: 有那麼明顯嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone's new once. I'm Ana.
dialogue.zh: 每個人都曾是新手,我叫安娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dan. I signed up on the internet.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæn aɪ saɪnd ʌp ɑn ði ˈɪntərˌnɛt/
dialogue.zh: 我是丹,在網上報的名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found you — beginner hour at seven.
dialogue.zh: 找到你啦,七點是初階時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One problem… I have no mat.
dialogue.zh: 有個問題……我沒有墊子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loaners by the door, take one.
dialogue.zh: 門口有借用的,拿一張就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the fee — is it a huge thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə fi ɪz ɪt ə hjuːdʒ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還有費用——很貴嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drop-in is twelve, or class packs.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑp ɪn ɪz twɛlz ɔr klæs pæks/
dialogue.zh: 單堂是十二塊,也可以買套票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Class packs? How does that work?
dialogue.zh: 套票?那是怎麼算的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy four, pay forty. Each is ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ fɔr peɪ ˈfɔrti itʃ ɪz tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 買四堂付四十,一堂算十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, if the class doesn't hate me.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld ɪf ðə klæs ˈdʌzənt heɪt mi/
dialogue.zh: 成交,只要課堂上的同學別討厭我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classes never hate anyone. Shoes off, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsəz ˈnɛvər heɪt ˈɛnɪˌwʌn ʃuz ɔf pliz/
dialogue.zh: 課堂才不會討厭誰呢。請把鞋子脫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Um, where's the… empty spot?
dialogue.zh: 好了。呃,哪個位子……是空的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, we're full — but wait, one just canceled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑː wir fʊl bʌt weɪt wʌn dʒʌst ˈkænsəld/
dialogue.zh: 啊,本來滿了——等等,剛好有人請假。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just canceled? Lucky me.
dialogue.zh: 剛好請假?我真幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maya stays home tonight. It's yours!
dialogue.zh: 小薇今晚在家,這個位子給你了!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… what now, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 好……接下來確切該做什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mat down, stand at the back if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæt daʊn stænd æt ðə bæk ɪf ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 鋪好墊子,需要的話就站最後一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. My back… it's office-back.
dialogue.zh: 記下了。我的腰呀……是久坐的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Desk worker? Very common here.
dialogue.zh: 坐辦公室的吧?這裡很多這類學員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty years of desk.
dialogue.zh: 在電腦前坐了好二十年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll bend your knees. Lots.
dialogue.zh: 那我們會多彎彎你的膝蓋,很多次數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bend knees? Don't I stand straight?
dialogue.zh: 彎膝蓋?不是該站直嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft knees protect them. Watch — like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft niz prəˈtɛkt ðɛm wɑtʃ laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋留一點軟才傷不了。看,就像這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that feels… smarter.
dialogue.zh: 噢,這樣果然……聰明多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Class starts — take your spot.
dialogue.zh: 要上課了,回到你的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Downward… what?
dialogue.zh: 向下……什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Downward dog. Shape an upside-down V.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdaʊnwərd dɔɡ ʃeɪp æn ˈʌpˌsaɪd daʊn vi/
dialogue.zh: 下犬式,身體撐成倒過來的V字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? I look like a folded napkin.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs aɪ lʊk laɪk ə ˈfoʊldɪd ˈnæpkɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣?我看起來像張折起來的餐巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A very honest napkin. Pedal your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈvɛri ˈɑnəst ˈnæpkɪn ˈpɛdəl jɔr fit/
dialogue.zh: 一張很老實的餐巾。雙腳像踩踏板那樣動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pedal? Walk the feet?
dialogue.zh: 踩踏板?就是兩腳輪流踩?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. One heel, then the other.
dialogue.zh: 完全對,一隻腳跟踩,再換另一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is… actually good.
dialogue.zh: 這感覺……竟然很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe, and stay off your phone.
dialogue.zh: 呼吸,還有別滑手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry — old habit, checking time.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉,老毛病,想看幾點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time flies here — that's the point.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡時間會飛快,這就是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poetic. What's the resting pose?
dialogue.zh: 說得真美。那個休息的動作是什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Savasana — lie down, eyes closed.
dialogue.zh: 大休息式,躺下,閉上眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I really sleep? It's a nap?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ˈrɪli slip ɪts ə næp/
dialogue.zh: 真的要用睡的嗎?這是午睡?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost. Rest counts as practice.
dialogue.zh: 差不多,休息也算在練習裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best news of the evening.
dialogue.zh: 這是今晚最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gong time — slowly come back up.
dialogue.zh: 銅鑼響了,慢慢地回到坐姿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Risen. Wow… my back is quiet.
dialogue.zh: 起來了。哇……我的腰居然安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the magic of five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 那就是五分鐘的小魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay — how soon can I return?
dialogue.zh: 好,我多久可以再來上一堂?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beginner series starts Monday, same hour.
dialogue.zh: 初階系列課週一開,一樣的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four classes for forty, right?
dialogue.zh: 四堂四十塊,對吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Paper form or email?
dialogue.zh: 對。要紙本報名還是用信箱?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email. My handwriting's an emergency.
dialogue.zh: 信箱吧,我的字醜得像緊急事件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Signed, and the mat comes home too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ saɪnd ænd ðə mæt kʌmz hoʊm tu/
dialogue.zh: 哈!報好名了,墊子也可以帶回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can borrow it between classes?
dialogue.zh: 我可以兩堂課之間把它借回家?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours for the series. Strap's right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz fər ðə ˈsɪriz stræps raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 整個系列課都歸你。背帶就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You turned scary into simple.
dialogue.zh: 你把可怕的事變得超簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's every beginner's first week.
dialogue.zh: 每位新手的頭一週都是如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday, then. Same back corner?
dialogue.zh: 那就週一再見。還是最後面那個角落?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same spot, same honest napkin.
dialogue.zh: 同樣的位置,同樣那張老實的餐巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Thanks, Ana. See you Monday.
dialogue.zh: 哈!謝謝妳,安娜。週一再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Namaste, Dan — rest well tonight.
dialogue.zh: 合十,丹——今晚好好休息。
